build.beforeDevCommand: bun run wasm-build:dev && bun run dev
build.beforeBuildCommand: bun run wasm-build && bun run build

security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob: asset: http://asset.localhost; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'
